title: Popular Manual of Mary’s sodality: vows honor her as witness and terminate the promise in her
source_text: XXXIII. Caeterum doctrina illa Bellarmini jam exposita, de votis quae Sanctis nuncupantur, atque ad ipsos terminantur, in Ecclesia Romana communis & popularis est, utpote tradita libris, qui sunt in communi usu plebis Romanae. Sic enim habet liber qui dicitur Manuale sodalitatis Beatae Mariae, Ad haec votis illi nuncupatis honorem tribuimus, non tantum quatenus Deo Vovemus, ex parentis ejus Mariae amore & reverentia, illam quasi testem obligationis, qua nos Deo obstringimus appellantes, ac illius gloriosa ac potenti intercessione statuentes & Sperantes ratam promissionem reddi votumque dependere, sed etiam ipsum votum & promissionem in eam terminantes. cap. 2. part. 3. num. 7.
pass_a_gloss: Moreover that doctrine of Bellarmine already exposed, concerning vows which are vowed to the Saints and are terminated on them, is common and popular in the Roman Church, as being handed down in books which are in the common use of the Roman people. For thus the book called Manual of the sodality of Blessed Mary has it: Besides, by vows vowed to her we render honor, not only insofar as we Vow to God, from love and reverence of His parent Mary, calling her as it were witness of the obligation by which we bind ourselves to God, and by her glorious and powerful intercession establishing and Hoping that the promise be made good and the vow depend, but also terminating the vow itself and the promise upon her. chapter 2, part 3, number 7.
pass_b_english: Bellarmino’s terminating Saint-vows are not niche—they sit in popular sodality manuals.
Mary’s Manual: vow to God with Mary as witness and intercessor—and terminate the promise in her.
